name: DBD OpenAPI — juristic person (OPEN, no key)
note: Open official company API. GET /api/v1/juristic_person/{13-digit-id} -> JSON (id, name TH/EN, type, register date, status, TSIC objective, register+paid-up capital THB, structured address). No token. Per-company by 13-digit juristic ID; iterate over an ID worklist. Verified: PTT 0107544000108, Bangkok Bank 0107536000374, CP All 0107542000011, INET 0107544000094.
